name: @narduk-enterprises/narduk-mapkit
description: Framework-agnostic Apple MapKit JS token, geometry, runtime, and playback helpers.
//dependencies: @apple/mapkit-loader became a real dependency in 2.1.0 (narduk-libs#421 section d): ./client loads MapKit JS v6 through Apple's own loader, and Apple's types arrive with it -- @types/apple-mapkit is a runtime dependency OF the loader, so a consumer resolves the published .d.ts without installing anything extra. ./server, ./node, ./worker and ./token never reach it: the loader is behind a dynamic import inside initializeMapKit(). @nuxt/kit and h3 join them for the ./nuxt entry (narduk-libs#422 section b): the module is defineNuxtModule and the token route is an h3 event handler. Neither is reachable from ., ./client, ./geometry, ./playback, ./server, ./node, ./worker, ./token or ./testing -- tests/testing/package-boundary.test.ts walks that graph.
//devDependencies: @types/apple-mapkit stays declared here as well because pnpm's isolated node_modules does not expose a transitive dependency to this package's own typecheck. The ./testing fake declares its own public types structurally, so the published .d.ts resolves without Apple's types installed; the link back to the real surface is tests/testing/apple-types.test.ts, which compares the fake member by member against apple-mapkit/mapkit and fails typecheck on drift. happy-dom is pinned to the exact version already resolved in this workspace's lockfile (see the narduk-mapkit-nuxt package.json note) -- a caret range makes pnpm re-resolve the shared entry for every other package (narduk-libs#124).
//peerDependencies: Optional on purpose: nine of the ten published entries are framework-free, and a consumer of ./geometry or ./worker must not be told it is missing Nuxt. Only ./nuxt needs them, and a consumer of ./nuxt has all three by construction. @nuxt/schema is named because dist/nuxt/index.d.ts refers to its NuxtModule type: @nuxt/kit types defineNuxtModule with it but does not re-export it, so a consumer under pnpm's isolated node_modules needs its own resolution path to it.
